body:
Found by the first cold start on a repo that is not hkb on 2026-08-27 (a private, org-owned monorepo with live CI).

`ensureGitignore`'s `wanted` list (`src/init.js:285`) is:

    .kanban/logs/  .kanban/outbox.jsonl  .kanban/state.json  .kanban/cache.json
    .kanban/nudges/  .kanban/sessions/  .claude/worktrees/

It does not include `.kanban/dispatch.pid`.

This repo's own `.gitignore` does include it — added by `9b6914d` ("Untrack the dispatcher pidfile") after we tripped over it here. The lesson was learned on hkb and never shipped to adopters: the first person to run `hkb dispatch --loop` and then `git add -A` commits a pidfile carrying their host and pid.

**Fix.** Add `.kanban/dispatch.pid` to `wanted`, and diff the rest of that list against this repo's `.gitignore` while there, so the same drift is not sitting in another entry.

**Verify.** `ensureGitignore` on a fixture repo writes the pidfile line; a repo that already has it is left unchanged (the function filters per-line, so it stays idempotent).
title: The shipped .gitignore misses .kanban/dispatch.pid
